identification: Box of glass. Four pale green hock/Roemer wine glasses with gilt scrolling foliage on the bowl, ribbed (spiral-trailed) conical stems and gilt rims, in the style of Bohemian/Moser or Theresienthal late 19th c. Three amber Roemer glasses with etched vine bowls, blue raspberry prunts and blue thread-wound stems (Rhine wine style, Bohemian/German c.1900). One Venetian style hexagonal flared goblet with gold flecks (aventurine/gold leaf inclusions) and a swirled knop, probably Murano, mid 20th c. Plus 2 pressed glass dishes (an amber-flash pedestal compote and a clear square dish). Estimate 60-80, no bids yet (current bid blank).
marks_seen: No maker marks, signatures or labels visible on any photo. Gilt decoration appears worn-free in photos; no chips visible but not checkable at photo resolution.
